feeds.title: Behavioural Freedom Blog
feeds.description: I'm Gillian Wingard. For 25 years I worked in the fast-paced, continually-changing corporate world of sales and recruitment as a senior manager. I witnessed first-hand how stress and anxiety in such a pressure-cooker environment affects people at all levels. That's why I started Behavioural Freedom.

feeds.title: Counselling and CBT Blog
feeds.description: I'm a BABCP accredited Psychotherapist with over 20 years experience. I specialise in a type of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) called Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT). I also offer Counselling for people who would prefer a none directive approach.Are you struggling with anxiety, feeling overwhelmed and out of control ? Finding professional help could be the first step to helping you get your life back on track.

feeds.title: Patricia Murphy Blog
feeds.description: The blog for Patricia Murphy featuring articles and stories around CBT. Including stories and blogs about clinical practice, new developments, poetry, books, music, art, cultural events and reviews and what they tell us about being human

feeds.title: CBT Hathi Therapies Blog
feeds.description: I am a Cognitive Behaviour Therapist, Integrative Psychotherapist, Nurse Specialist (Mental Health), Mum, Youth Worker, Trainer. The aim of CBT Hathi Therapies is to work with you to make positive change with the help of professional counselling psychotherapy services.Offering Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT) and Integrative Psychotherapies. We specialise in Psychological Trauma, Depression, Anxiety and Stress related issues.

feeds.title: The Thomas Connection Blog
feeds.description: The Thomas Connection provides Psychological therapy and coaching for individuals, couples, parents, and corporate clients, using CBT, ACT, and Compassion Focused Therapy.

feeds.title: CBT Therapy Manchester Blog
feeds.description: CBT Therapy Manchester is a talking therapy that can help you manage your current difficulties and challenges by looking at alternative methods.

feeds.title: Belfast Cognitive Therapy Centre Blog
feeds.description: Belfast Cognitive Therapy Centre was established in 1996 to help develop rigorous standards of counselling, therapy and training.

feeds.title: The Harley Psychology Group Blog
feeds.description: The British CBT & Counselling Service are Doctors of Psychology specialising in CBT for adults, families & children. Follow this blog to get a clear understanding of the origins and development of problems and learn comprehensive techniques to eliminate these and prevent their return.
